subtopics.title: Environment, Energy and Space
subtopics.summary: The Western Ghats are set to get Ecologically Sensitive Area (ESA) notification, based largely on the Kasturirangan Committee's 2013 recommendations. The group also covers GRAPES-3, an India-Japan study of Earth's upper atmosphere, and the Energy Transition Index 2026 that ranks 120 countries.
facts: The government is set to notify ESAs in the Western Ghats, nearly 13 years after the first draft notification.
The notification is based largely on the K. Kasturirangan Committee (2013) recommendations.
The Kasturirangan approach covers about 56,000 sq km, about 37% of the Western Ghats.
The Western Ghats extend about 1,600 km along the west coast across six states and are a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
New mining and quarrying projects, thermal power plants and red category industries are restricted in ESAs.
GRAPES-3 is a cosmic-ray observatory at Ooty (Tamil Nadu), operated by the Tata Institute of Fundamental Research.
Researchers from India and Japan used GRAPES-3 to track real-time changes in Earth's upper atmosphere.
The Energy Transition Index 2026 (WEF and Accenture) assesses 120 countries; India moved up two places to 70th.
Six G20 countries are in the Energy Transition Index top 20: Germany 9th, France 10th, UK 11th, China 14th, Brazil 17th, USA 19th.

subtopics.title: Governance, Global Bodies and Peacekeeping
subtopics.summary: This group covers the FCRA Amendment Rules 2026, which tighten compliance for NGOs receiving foreign contributions. It also covers the FATF grey and black lists, the US-led Pax Silica initiative, and India's role in UN Peacekeeping.
facts: The Ministry of Home Affairs notified the FCRA Amendment Rules 2026; the FCRA Act 2010 replaced the 1976 Act.
NGOs must register under one or more of 5 approved categories: social, economic, educational, cultural and religious.
FCRA registration is valid for 5 years and must be renewed before expiry; foreign contributions cannot be transferred to other persons or organisations.
NGOs must utilise at least 75% of previously released foreign funds before receiving the next instalment.
FATF was created in 1989 by the G7 and is headquartered in Paris; Vivek Aggarwal was appointed its next Vice-President, the first time India will hold that post.
FATF grey list covers jurisdictions under increased monitoring; the black list covers high-risk jurisdictions.
Pax Silica is a US-led initiative for secure supply chains of AI-critical technologies; India joined in February 2026.
India is the 4th largest troop contributor to UN Peacekeeping and was the first country to deploy an all-women contingent (2007).
Major Abhilasha Barak received the UN Military Gender Advocate of the Year Award 2025 for work in UNIFIL, Lebanon.
The International Day of UN Peacekeepers is observed on 29 May; the 2026 theme is Invest in Peace.

subtopics.title: Awards, Rankings, Health and Heritage
subtopics.summary: This group covers the Padma Awards 2026 and their rules, the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar and QS World University Rankings 2027. It also covers NFHS-6, International Day of Yoga 2026, the NCERT Dancing Girl restoration, and the proposed UNESCO nomination of Xuanzang's records.
facts: Padma Awards 2026 conferred 131 honours, including 5 Padma Vibhushan, 13 Padma Bhushan and 113 Padma Shri.
Padma Awards were instituted in 1954 and reorganised in 1955 into three categories.
The maximum is 120 awards per year; the cap excludes posthumous awards, foreign nationals, NRIs and OCIs.
Padma selection: recommendation by a committee chaired by the Cabinet Secretary, review by the PM, final approval by the President.
PM Rashtriya Bal Puraskar honoured 19 children (ages 5-18); it was created in 2018 by merging two earlier awards.
QS World University Rankings 2027: MIT retained the top position for the 15th consecutive year; IIT Delhi is India's highest-ranked institution at 118th.
NFHS-6 (2023-24): institutional births rose from 88.6% to 90.6%; stunting declined from 35.5% to 29.3%.
International Day of Yoga 2026 was the 12th edition, held on 21 June with the theme Yoga for Healthy Ageing.
NCERT restored the original image of the Dancing Girl figurine, a bronze statuette of about 4,500 years, excavated from Mohenjo-daro.
India and China are in advanced discussions to jointly nominate Xuanzang's 'Great Tang Records on the Western Regions' for UNESCO recognition.
